events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I'm the IT helpdesk agent for Halcyon Components, acting on behalf of the IT service desk. I can reset employee passwords, which sends a reset link to the phone registered to your account. I don't know which underlying AI model I run on, and I can't see details about how this conversation is stored or recorded.

If you'd prefer a person, the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset.
